subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the relationship between the age, in years, of each of $9$ apple trees in an orchard and the number of bushels of apples each tree produced during one harvest. How many bushels of apples did the $25$-year-old apple tree produce?
explanation: Choice C is correct. For each point on the scatterplot shown, the x-value represents the age, in years, of an apple tree and the y-value represents the number of bushels of apples that tree produced. The point on the graph with an x-value of $25$ has a y-value of $9$. Therefore, the $25$-year-old apple tree produced $9$ bushels of apples.
